components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Most frequent action on a screen. At most one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font: 600 16px/24px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366F1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #E75B7A; color: #FFFDFC; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #D9A3B0; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #F1F5F9; color: #CBD5E1; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; background: #FFFDFC; color: #0F172A; font: 600 16px/24px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F1F5F9; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366F1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Delete. Calm Ink Navy, always followed by an undo toast.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: #0F172A; color: #FFFDFC; font: 600 16px/24px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #334155; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366F1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labelled field; rose focus, red error.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 14px/20px inherit; color: #334155; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-input { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; background: #FFFDFC; color: #0F172A; font: 400 16px/24px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748B; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #E75B7A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(231 91 122 / 0.2); } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: #E5484D; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: #F1F5F9; width: 320px; } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #334155; font: 500 14px/20px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #0F172A; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked=true] { background: #E75B7A; color: #FFFDFC; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6366F1; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Bebè is the paper diary two parents keep on the changing table, rebuilt so it lives on both of their phones at once. A notebook has no dashboard: it has the last entry, written plainly, and a column of times down the margin. The system borrows that honesty. The palette is soft and domestic: a warm cream page, one confident rose for the thing you do most, and a set of pastel category tints that behave like colored tabs in a notebook. Type is a single, well-tuned Inter at a modest scale. This system explicitly rejects the SaaS dashboard and the ad-heavy baby tracker, and treats the dark theme as a first-class, night-safe surface.
keyCharacteristics: Single mobile column, max 512px wide, 16px side gutter, bottom tab bar.
Answer-first home: a dark status panel phrased as a sentence, then primary logging keys, then today.
Category color = soft pastel tile + saturated icon + text label, always all three.
Rounded, soft geometry (12px elements, 16px cards, 24px feature panels, 28px sheets).
Bottom sheets for quick logging, undo toasts instead of confirmation dialogs.
Responsive motion: press feedback, sheet slide-up, live-session pulse. Nothing else moves.

rules.name: The Notebook Tab Rule
rules.body: Category color is a tab, not a theme. A category tint may fill its own tile, icon chip or chart series; it never tints a whole screen, a header, or text paragraphs.

rules.name: The One Rose Rule
rules.body: Nursery Rose fills at most one large element per screen (the primary action or the running timer). Everything else rose is small.

rules.name: The Calm Red Rule
rules.body: Alert Red means something went wrong with your data. Normal events, including medicines and vaccines, are never red.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration, quantity and timer uses tabular figures. Numbers that shift width while ticking are forbidden.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons and headings are sentence case in Italian. No all-caps, no letter-spaced eyebrow labels.

rules.name: The Paper-On-Table Rule
rules.body: If a shadow is noticeable at a glance, it is too strong. Elevation should read like a sheet of paper lying on a table.

dos: Do lead every screen with the answer: the Home status panel's Display sentence comes before any button.
Do keep frequent actions in the lower half of the screen and at least 44×44px; Home logging keys are 84px and 118px tall.
Do show every category as tint + ink icon + text label, all three, every time.
Do use tabular figures for all times, durations, quantities and timers.
Do use undo toasts (Paper, 16px radius, Toast shadow) instead of confirmation dialogs for deletes and edits.
Do keep transitions between 150 and 250ms with exponential ease-out; press feedback is scale(0.98).
Do design the dark theme on its own: Night Canvas (#0B1120) base, no Paper or Snow fills larger than a button, at most one filled Nursery Rose element per screen.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: the live pulse and sheet slide become instant.
donts: Don't build a SaaS dashboard: no KPI tiles, no hero-metric blocks (big number, small label, trend arrow), no grids of identical stat cards, no gradients.
Don't make it an ad-heavy baby tracker: no banners, premium upsell badges, streaks, gamification, or engagement nags; no crowded home screen with every feature competing.
Don't use gender-coded pink-for-girls / blue-for-boys theming; the palette is the same for every baby.
Don't use Alert Red (#E5484D) for normal events; red means a data problem.
Don't fill whole screens or headers with a category tint (The Notebook Tab Rule).
Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored stripe on rows, cards or toasts.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or decorative blur (the sheet scrim is the only blur, at 2px).
Don't add a second typeface, all-caps labels, or letter-spaced eyebrows.
Don't open a modal dialog when a sheet, inline edit, or undo toast would do.
Don't animate anything that isn't feedback or a state change; no page-load choreography.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#FFF) anywhere; use Ink Navy and Paper.
